messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: High GPU queue growth detected in cluster gpu-eu-1 - queue >1500, enqueue rate sustained 1.2k/s. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
raj (oncall): oncall ack. looking at dashboards now. linking queue view.
emily (eng-sre): I see spike in pending requests for model-render workers. HPA not scaling - hpa metrics show 'no current metrics'. suspect custom metrics path.
rachel (eng-runtime): checking prometheus-adapter logs: repeated 502s from adapter to API server when fetching custom metrics. adapter traces show `503 upstream` to prometheus query frontend.
support-bot: customer-alerts: 3 customers affected (C-921, C-922, C-925) experiencing timeouts and 429s. auto-notify sent.
raj (oncall): quick status: pods in gpu pool are at 100% memory, CPU low. HPA currentReplicas=3 desiredReplicas=3. loads on node ephemeral storage high.
tom (infra): cloud metrics show node provisioning delays and quota nearing limit for GPU type `nvidia-a100`. also noticing a big Prometheus remote_write backfill job running in infra-monitoring started ~01:10 UTC.
emily (eng-sre): that backfill could be saturating TSDB ingest path; prometheus query latency > 20s which leads adapter to fail. HPA waiting on custom metric `inference_queue_length` which isn't returned.
raj (oncall): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T01:24:02Z prometheus-frontend warn: query processing time exceeded, dropping request
2026-03-15T01:24:03Z prometheus-adapter error: upstream query failed: 503 Service Unavailable
2026-03-15T01:24:04Z kube-controller-manager info: HPA: missing metrics for scale target inference/deployment/model-render
```
rachel (eng-runtime): runtime observation: KV cache on several GPU pods full, spilling to disk causing OOMKill on one pod recently. need to drain before scaling new pods.
emily (eng-sre): mitigation plan suggestion: 1) short-circuit traffic to reserve pool (gpu-hot-standby), 2) manually increase HPA minReplicas to force scale while adapter recovers, 3) stop non-critical remote_write/backfill job.
raj (oncall): applying steps. enabling emergency routing flag to send 25% traffic to gpu-hot-standby.
deploy-bot: routing-change: split applied (75/25) to (gpu-eu-1,gpu-hot-standby) by raj at 01:36 UTC
tom (infra): killing remote_write backfill job now to free TSDB ingestion. should reduce prometheus latency in ~60-90s. also freeing two reserved GPU quota from perf-testing pool.
zoe (oncall-next): prepping to take handoff in 20m.
raj (oncall): forcing HPA minReplicas=6: `kubectl patch hpa model-render -n inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'` - this will force controller to create replicas even if custom metrics absent.
emily (eng-sre): created patch. controller will create pods; note node provisioning may be the bottleneck. recommend hot-add nodes to nodepool gpu-eu-1-autoscale.
tom (infra): hot-adding 4 nodes to gpu-eu-1-autoscale; cloud reports provisioning started. ETA ~4m.
rachel (eng-runtime): applying runtime fallback: redirect long-running batch jobs to batch-only pool and reduce per-request GPU memory by switching to quantized model variant for interactive traffic.
support-bot: updated customers: mitigation in progress, expected partial restoration in 10-15m.
raj (oncall): monitoring queue: peak 1560 -> 820 after routing and HPA patch. HPA desired now effectively 8 (manual min) current 3, pods launching.
emily (eng-sre): prometheus latency falling back to ~1s after backfill job kill. adapter logs show successful metric responses now.
raj (oncall): HPA reports desired 8 current 6 -> scaling continues. queue trending down to 300.
zoe (oncall-next): taking handoff at 01:50 UTC. keep list of followups.
raj (oncall): handoff summary:
- suspected root cause: Prometheus remote_write/backfill job + TSDB pressure => query latency -> prometheus-adapter timeouts -> HPA not receiving custom metrics -> no autoscaling -> GPU queue buildup.
- customer impact: transient timeouts and throttles for several customers; support notified.
- mitigations performed: stopped backfill job, freed GPU quota, hot-added nodes, patched HPA minReplicas, split traffic to reserve pool, switched runtime to lower-memory model variant.
- immediate followups: infra to schedule backfill during low-traffic window and add throttle; runtime to add adapter circuit-breaker and cached fallback for queue metric; eng-sre to own postmortem (emily).
emily (eng-sre): I'll take PM for RCA and coordinate with infra/runtime. tagging @tom and @rachel for followups.
zoe (oncall-next): monitoring until stable. queue <200 and request latency back to normal baseline. keeping incident open for postmortem notes.
support-bot: customers notified of mitigation and will await RCA.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: P1 -> mitigated at 02:10 UTC. auto-close scheduled in 2h.
